scenario_context: Package marked delivered but not received. Verify details, check safe drop, open carrier investigation, set timeline, explain resolution options after investigation window.

customer_profile.opening_message: Tracking says delivered but I didn’t receive anything.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent initiates investigation + provides clear timeline and options

checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Start with empathy before logistics questions.

checkpoints.description: Check safe-drop options (neighbor, concierge, reception, doorstep)

checkpoints.description: Initiate carrier investigation and set update timeline
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Start investigation and give a next update time.

checkpoints.description: Explain replacement/refund options after investigation window
